title: Diagnostic accuracy of circulating microRNAs in Alzheimer's disease and Parkinson's disease: data, code and results
description: Search exports, extraction tables with the verbatim source sentence for every value, audit log, analysis and figure scripts, and result tables for a systematic review and meta-analysis of circulating microRNAs as diagnostic biomarkers in Alzheimer's disease and Parkinson's disease. Registered retrospectively on OSF (10.17605/OSF.IO/NJ8A5).
